# GuitarFX: the internal values

<!-- Generated by `cargo run -p xtask -- parameters` in guitarfx/ from the registry (guitarfx-dsp/src/params.rs) and the English texts. Do not edit: guitarfx/xtask/tests/parameters_doc.rs fails when this page differs from the registry. -->

Every internal value of GuitarFX's sound, 103 in all. Each can be changed in the *Advanced* window (Defaults puts them all back) or in the file `settings.properties` of the settings folder, as `key=value`; a value outside its range is brought to the nearer bound, and one that is not a number is ignored (the default stays). The reverb's and the echo's steps are lowered when needed, so that every repeat dies away. A change takes effect the next time the sound is turned on; the plugin reads the same file when the host starts it. The defaults are the tested ones; a value TuxGuitarAdvanced's *Amp and effects* also has is the same there.

The settings folder: `~/Library/Application Support/GuitarFX` on macOS, `%APPDATA%\GuitarFX` on Windows, `~/.config/guitarfx` on Linux (or `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/guitarfx`).

## Output and safety

| Key | Name | Unit | Default | Minimum | Maximum | What it does |
|---|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| `guitarfx.output.ceiling` | Ceiling | dBFS | -1 | -12 | 0 | The loudest the output may be; the limiter holds every sample under it. |
| `guitarfx.output.fade-in` | Fade in | s | 0.5 | 0.05 | 3 | How long the sound takes to rise when it is turned on. |
| `guitarfx.output.fade-out` | Fade out | s | 0.02 | 0.005 | 0.5 | How long the sound takes to fall when it is turned off or muted. |
| `guitarfx.output.release` | Limiter release | s | 0.05 | 0.005 | 1 | How fast the limiter lets the level come back after a peak. |

## Feedback guard

| Key | Name | Unit | Default | Minimum | Maximum | What it does |
|---|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| `guitarfx.feedback.above-median` | Above the median | dB | 20 | 6 | 40 | How far a peak must stand above the spectrum's median to be a howl. Higher: fewer false alarms, a later catch. |
| `guitarfx.feedback.narrow` | Narrowness | dB | 10 | 3 | 30 | How far the peak must stand above its neighbours on both sides (a howl is a single narrow tone). |
| `guitarfx.feedback.narrow-bins` | Neighbour distance | bins | 4 | 1 | 16 | How far, in spectrum bins, those neighbours are. |
| `guitarfx.feedback.loud` | Loud level | dBFS | -12 | -40 | 0 | A peak held above this level is a howl even if it does not grow. |
| `guitarfx.feedback.hold` | Duration | s | 0.3 | 0.05 | 2 | How long a peak must last before it counts. |
| `guitarfx.feedback.rise` | Rise | dB | 15 | 3 | 40 | How much a peak must grow during that time to be a howl. |
| `guitarfx.feedback.fall-tolerance` | Dip allowed | dB | 1 | 0 | 10 | How much a growing peak may dip between two looks and still count as growing. |
| `guitarfx.feedback.drift` | Drift | bins | 1 | 0 | 8 | How far the peak may move between two looks and still be the same tone. |

## Feedback guard: analysis

| Key | Name | Unit | Default | Minimum | Maximum | What it does |
|---|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| `guitarfx.feedback-analysis.low` | Lowest frequency | Hz | 60 | 20 | 500 | The lowest frequency watched. |
| `guitarfx.feedback-analysis.high` | Highest frequency | Hz | 12000 | 2000 | 20000 | The highest frequency watched. |
| `guitarfx.feedback-analysis.hop` | Look interval | s | 0.01 | 0.002 | 0.1 | How often the spectrum is looked at. |

## Devices

| Key | Name | Unit | Default | Minimum | Maximum | What it does |
|---|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| `guitarfx.devices.block` | Block size | frames | 128 | 16 | 1024 | The size of the blocks the chain processes. Smaller: less delay, more work. |
| `guitarfx.devices.ring-blocks` | Waiting blocks | blocks | 2 | 1 | 16 | How many input blocks may wait; older ones are dropped and counted. |
| `guitarfx.devices.clipping` | Clipping level | dBFS | -0.1 | -6 | 0 | An input peak above this level shows the clipping message. |
| `guitarfx.devices.resample-fill` | Resampler fill | blocks | 2 | 1 | 8 | How full the resampler keeps its buffer when input and output rates differ. |
| `guitarfx.devices.resample-adjust` | Ratio change | × | 0.005 | 0.0005 | 0.05 | The largest change of the resampling ratio, as a fraction. |
| `guitarfx.devices.resample-gain` | Ratio following | ×/frame | 0.00002 | 0.000001 | 0.001 | How strongly the ratio follows the buffer's fill. |
| `guitarfx.devices.resample-smoothing` | Fill smoothing | × | 0.02 | 0.001 | 0.5 | How much the measured fill is smoothed. |

## Smooth changes

| Key | Name | Unit | Default | Minimum | Maximum | What it does |
|---|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| `guitarfx.smooth.crossfade` | Switch crossfade | s | 0.01 | 0.001 | 0.1 | The crossfade when a pedal is switched on or off. |
| `guitarfx.smooth.dip` | Reorder dip | s | 0.005 | 0.001 | 0.05 | Each half of the short dip when the pedals are reordered. |
| `guitarfx.smooth.glide-step` | Glide step | samples | 8 | 1 | 64 | How often a gliding filter recomputes its coefficients. |
| `guitarfx.smooth.character` | Character dip | s | 0.01 | 0.002 | 0.1 | The dip when the amp's character changes. |
| `guitarfx.smooth.cabinet` | Cabinet crossfade | s | 0.01 | 0.001 | 0.1 | The crossfade when the cabinet is switched. |
| `guitarfx.smooth.echo-time` | Echo time crossfade | s | 0.01 | 0.001 | 0.1 | The crossfade when the echo's time changes, and the echo's opening after a reset. |
| `guitarfx.smooth.opening` | Opening | s | 0.01 | 0.001 | 0.1 | How fast the chorus and the reverb open after a reset. |

## Overload

| Key | Name | Unit | Default | Minimum | Maximum | What it does |
|---|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| `guitarfx.overload.budget` | Time budget | × | 0.5 | 0.1 | 1 | A block whose processing takes more than this share of its duration is slow. |
| `guitarfx.overload.blocks` | Slow blocks | blocks | 20 | 2 | 200 | How many slow blocks in a row lighten the sound. |

|---|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---|

| `guitarfx.gate.hold` | Hold | s | 0.01 | 0 | 0.5 | How long the gate stays open after the sound falls. |
| `guitarfx.gate.open` | Opening | s | 0.00025 | 0.00005 | 0.01 | How fast the gate opens on an attack. |
| `guitarfx.gate.rms` | Measure time | s | 0.005 | 0.001 | 0.05 | The time over which the level is measured. |
| `guitarfx.gate.release-range` | Release range | dB | 60 | 20 | 120 | How many decibels the gate falls during its release time. |
